description: This file contains Sass mixins for styling form validation states, focus states, and sizing in forms, used as part of theme styling in a CSS preprocessor context.

methods.name: form-control-validation
methods.description: Mixin for styling form controls, labels, help texts, and validation states such as warning, error, and success messages.

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: Mixin for customizing the focus state of form controls with a specified color.

methods.name: input-size
methods.description: Mixin for adjusting sizes of form controls, including height, padding, font size, line height, and border radius, for various input elements.
